text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after a round of training with
Mejiro
Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
My pecs, my traps, my quads... I can
hear all my
muscles yelling out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
They want more... They want to keep
this burn
going even longer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ooh yeah, I'm feeling the real burn now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not sure what's happening, but it
sounds like
Mejiro Ryan wants to
continue training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna turn that screaming... into an
orchestra
of muscular perfection!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan, the muscle conductor,
works up a
nice sweat with some extra
training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh... You're right, I didn't even think
about it that
way!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, guess I need to listen to my
muscles more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, little buddies! Can you hear me?
That's all
for today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan is talking to her muscles.
After some
discussion, they decide to
take a break.
